Definition: to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate
BiblicalUsage: Bachan means to test — to try metals in the fire, and to try men the same way. God tells the prophet he has set him as a tower and a fortress to know and try the people's way, Jeremiah says the Lord trieth the righteous, Job says when he hath tried me I shall come forth as gold, and Zechariah promises God will refine his people as silver is refined and try them as gold is tried.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God tests his people the way a refiner tests silver — not to destroy them but to burn away the dross. Job's gold is my hope: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
